exhibit_title: AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO NOTE PURCHASE AGREEMENT

quote: This Amendment No. 1 to Note Purchase Agreement (this "Amendment"), dated as of October 26, 2026, is entered into between Anthropic, PBC, a Delaware public benefit corporation (the "Company") and Broadcom Inc. (the "Investor", together with the Company, the "Parties").
